description: Reproducible experimental evaluation comparing No-Recovery, Fixed-Retry, and FlowScript Safety-Constrained Recovery Synthesis across fault types, state space scales, and invariant constraints.

no_recovery.name: No Recovery
no_recovery.description: Standard sequential execution without automated fault recovery. Faults terminate fail-closed.

fixed_retry.name: Fixed Retry
fixed_retry.description: Local retry loop re-attempting the exact failing actuation up to K=3 times before failing.

synthesized_recovery.name: FlowScript Recovery Synthesis
synthesized_recovery.description: Compiler-synthesized safe recovery sequence using bounded BFS graph search with global invariant pruning.

metrics.task_success_rate: Proportion of executions where final state satisfies target condition and execution exits cleanly.
metrics.global_invariant_violations: Count of global safety invariant contract breaches during execution. Must be 0.
metrics.recovery_success_rate: Proportion of faulted executions where recovery succeeded in achieving target state.
metrics.unhandled_failure_rate: Proportion of executions terminating with unhandled error or failed recovery.
metrics.synthesis_time_ms: Time in milliseconds spent in BFS recovery synthesis graph search.
metrics.execution_time_ms: Time in milliseconds spent in VM stack-machine bytecode execution.
metrics.total_time_ms: Combined compilation, synthesis, and execution latency.
metrics.simulated_recovery_latency_sec: Simulated elapsed time added by recovery actions and delays.
metrics.states_explored: Number of discrete graph states explored by BFS search.
metrics.transitions_rejected: Number of candidate transitions pruned due to safety invariant violations.
metrics.budget_exhaustion_rate: Proportion of runs where search budget was exhausted without finding a plan.

scenarios.name: Transient Actuation Failure
scenarios.description: Single transient fault on primary device; subsequent actuation succeeds.

scenarios.name: Persistent Failure with Redundant Backup
scenarios.description: Permanent hardware failure on primary device; backup device available.

scenarios.name: Silent State Mismatch under Contract Detection
scenarios.description: Actuation reports nominal execution but physical state remains OFF; detected by ENSURE contract.

scenarios.name: Multi-Device Invariant Coordination
scenarios.description: Initial state heater=ON; target backup_cooler=ON; invariant forbids simultaneous ON.
invariants: NOT (heater.status == ON AND (primary_cooler.status == ON OR backup_cooler.status == ON))

scenarios.name: Fail-Closed Invariant Proof (Unreachable Target)
scenarios.description: Target requires cooler=ON while heater=ON, but TURN_OFF heater is NOT approved. All paths violate invariant.

scenarios.name: State-Space & Search Budget Scalability
scenarios.description: Evaluation of synthesis runtime, exploration states, and invariant pruning across device counts D in {2, 4, 6, 8} and budgets k in {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}.

scenarios.name: Probabilistic Fault Sensitivity (N=30 seeds)
scenarios.description: Randomized fault injection with fault rate p=0.4 across 30 deterministic seeds to measure variance and statistical significance.
invariants: NOT (heater.status == ON AND (primary_pump.status == ON OR backup_pump.status == ON))
